  MINUTES
  MONTEREY PARK CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL COMMUNITY MEETING
  JUNE 11, 2025

The City Council of the City of Monterey Park held a Special Community Meeting of the
Council at The Langley Senior Center located at 400 W. Emerson Ave., Monterey Park
91754 on Wednesday, June 11, 2025, at 6:00 p.m.

1.  Call to Order
  City Manager Manager Alvarez called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m.

2.  Roll Call

  City Manager Alvarez called the roll:

  Council Members Present: Henry Lo arrived at 6:20 p.m., Thomas Wong
  Council Members Absent: Vinh Ngo , Jose Sanchez, Elizabeth Yang

  Also Present:
  City Manager Inez Alvarez
  Assistant City Manager Diana Garcia
  Director of Recreation and Community Services Robert Aguirre
  Interim Director of Community Development Phillip Lanzafame
  Acting City Librarian LV Frazier
  Police Chief Scott Wiese
  Public Works Manager Xochitl Tipan
  Assistant Deputy City Clerk Helena Cho
  Community Conversations

  I.  Welcome

  II.  Community members are invited for casual conversations and to learn
  more about City programs and services with Monterey Park Council
  Members and staff

  III.  Adjournment

  Due to a lack of quorum, the meeting was adjourned at 6:15 p.m. by City
  Manager Alvarez.

_________________
Maychelle Yee
City Clerk

  MISSION STATEMENT
 The mission of the City of Monterey Park is to provide excellent service, foster growth and opportunity,
  and create a joyous and collaborative environment.
  .
